name: Goi toi
summary: Gỏi tỏi is the young-garlic salad on Lý Sơn. Vietnam Airlines steams the garlic, shreds it, and mixes in boiled shrimp, pork belly, and rau răm. ZaloPay treats shrimp and pork as optional and does not say the garlic is steamed.
taste: Vietnam Airlines says the smell is strong but not harsh, and the plate is rich, nutty, sour, and hot. ZaloPay says mildly hot, rich, and cool.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: only in the season when the garlic starts to bulb. Steam the young garlic, shred it, and mix it with boiled shrimp, pork belly, rau răm, roasted peanuts, and sweet-sour fish sauce.
ZaloPay: the young garlic stem, mixed with sweet-sour fish sauce. Shrimp and pork may be added. Roasted peanuts go on last. It does not print the steam step or rau răm.
No hour was printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Lý Sơn. Neither publisher prints a street or a house number.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints 120,000 VND a plate. ZaloPay printed no price.
seoTitle: Goi toi — young-garlic salad on Ly Son
seoDescription: Young-garlic salad on Lý Sơn. Vietnam Airlines prints 120,000 VND a plate and includes shrimp and pork belly. ZaloPay calls them optional. The hour is Check on arrival.
